model: Trackformer1.1 whole western-Pacific causal state route + intensity/structure head (25% Pacific domain + 75% local)

pacific.policy: causal dynamic multi-level large-system analysis ensemble
pacific.input_policy: current, t-12, and t-24 analysis fields only; the lead evolution is a bounded extrapolation of their observed tendency; no future analysis, forecast product, official track, or future observed row
pacific.tendency_method: bounded current-minus-past analysis tendency, capped at two 12-hour differences
large_systems: Pacific subtropical ridge represented by broad 850/500-hPa flow and 500-hPa height field
midlatitude trough and jet influence represented by broad 500/200-hPa rings
pressure-gradient steering represented by causal SLP geostrophic component when supplied
pacific.large_system_policy: The route samples the complete analysis grid through broad 850/500/200-hPa and SLP-gradient views; nearby lows are represented by the same causal pressure field.

local.route_input_policy: Only current, t-12 h, and t-24 h analysis wind fields at or before the issue time were used. No forecast lead field, official forecast track, future observed row, or Tip data was used.
local.ensemble_mean_method: weighted mean after integrating 36 members: 3 causal snapshots x 4 level/radius views x 3 curvature variants
local.curvature_method: bilinear analysis-wind sampling around each evolving predicted center

pressure_state.tendency_method: 0.6 * (current - t-12) + 0.4 * (t-12 - t-24), clipped per channel at the 98th percentile
pressure_state.input_policy: current, t-12, and t-24 analysis fields only; no positive-lead or official forecast field

causal_input_guard.policy: analysis/reanalysis only; every weather valid_time <= issue_time and every GRIB step = 0

intensity_model.model: frozen Trackformer1.1 structure spatial structure ensemble used as the Trackformer1.1 intensity head
intensity_model.field_contract: 4x17x17 analysis-compatible analysis patch, q/31.75 then clipped to [-4,4]
intensity_model.ensemble_spread: standard deviation across the three frozen spatial experts

pressure_map_coupling.method: Trackformer1.1 forecast pressure-map query plus confidence-weighted local-minimum/anomaly-radius coupling
pressure_map_coupling.minimum_confidence: local minimum contribution decays with route-to-minimum offset; route-point map pressure remains the fallback
pressure_map_coupling.wind_pressure_anchor: observed current wind/pressure; map drives only future changes
pressure_map_coupling.radius_method: learned radius baseline rescaled by trusted local quadrant pressure-anomaly extent; max four-degree footprint

input_policy: Strict causal-only mode: the runner rejects any GRIB forecast step or weather valid_time after the issue. Only current/past GFS analysis files and the observed track history are used; the whole 100-190E, 0-60N state is extrapolated from current/t-12/t-24 analysis tendency. Official JMA/JTWC tracks are overlays only.

causal_input_guard.policy: analysis/reanalysis only; every weather valid_time <= issue_time and every GRIB step = 0

forecast_intensity_source: Trackformer1.1_intensity_structure.py using the frozen Trackformer1.1 structure spatial structure ensemble, coupled to the causal Trackformer1.1 pressure-map state; current/past analysis only
other_typhoon_input: No storm-center forecast or official typhoon track was used. Nearby lows/vortex candidates come from the causal SLP field.
